notes: Read SKILL.md, references/capabilities.md and references/non-hero-scenarios.md in full. Reference for the azure-mgmt-fabric Python management SDK: create/get/list/update/suspend/resume/delete Microsoft Fabric capacities, name availability, SKUs, LRO handling.

The only commands are `pip install azure-mgmt-fabric` and `pip install azure-identity` (lines 19-20), which is why the risk is medium; both are official packages. Everything else is sample code using DefaultAzureCredential and placeholder subscription/resource-group env vars; the agent is not told to read, print, or send secrets.

These are management-plane samples: running them creates, scales or deletes billable Fabric capacities in the user's Azure subscription, so the user's code should only run them deliberately. Sample inconsistencies: SKILL.md line 89 uses FabricCapacityAdministration without importing it; SKILL.md uses CapacitySku where references/non-hero-scenarios.md line 9 uses RpSku; list_skus is called with different arguments in the two files.
